links.outcome: Readability grade level of chatbot patient-education responses, plain-language customized vs general chatbots
links.effect: VERA (5th-grade system prompt) median FK grade 6.6 vs 7.5 ChatGPT, 9.0 Gemini, 8.0 Claude; Flesch Reading Ease 72 vs 52.5-57 (p<0.001 vs each). Comprehensiveness lower.
links.quote: VERA produced responses at a median grade level of 6.6 [4.7, 7.0] compared with 7.5 [6.2, 9.7] for ChatGPT, 9.0 [7.4, 10.2] for Gemini, and 8.0 [6.7, 9.0] for Claude.

links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy of knowledge-base-grounded chatbot vs ungrounded general chatbots
links.effect: Accuracy high across all chatbots; pooled overall difference p=0.02 but no pairwise differences after Holm correction; grounded VERA was less comprehensive (p<0.001 vs each).
links.quote: When accuracy scores were pooled across all prompts, there was a statistically significant overall difference among chatbots ( p = 0.02; Kruskal-Wallis); however, no pairwise comparisons remained statistically significant after Holm correction ( Table 4 ).
